title: Software Engineer II - (Ruby)
description:
Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.
Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.
In just over four years, we’ve helped more than 300 operators process tens of millions in automated payments. We’re recognised as innovators in our space, and we’re a fast-growing, product-led team focused on making self-storage better for everyone.
About the role
We’re hiring a mid-level Software Engineer to join our growing product team.
You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to build and improve our Rails-based platform, contributing to customer-facing features, internal tools and the ongoing stability and performance of the product.
This role is well suited to someone with solid Ruby on Rails experience who is comfortable working across the stack, including JavaScript and CSS when needed.
We work best with self-starting team players: people who take ownership, communicate clearly and enjoy working in small, focused teams. You’ll have support from senior engineers, but you should also be comfortable working independently on well-defined tasks.
What you'll be doing

• Build and maintain product features, taking ownership from initial discussion through to deployment.

• Collaborate with Product and other stakeholders to define and refine the scope of new features.

• Contribute to app maintenance. We aim to spend at least 20% of our time improving stability, performance and developer experience.

• Write and maintain tests so we can confidently deploy to production multiple times per day.

• Investigate, debug and resolve issues to keep the system stable as we scale.

• Act on monitoring insights to keep the app performant and reliable.

• Contribute to code reviews and team discussions.

• Learn from senior engineers and continue developing your skills in a collaborative environment.

Our technology stack
Backend: Rails 7, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq
Frontend: Hotwire/Turbo 8, targeted React, ViewComponents, Sass, BEM
Testing: Minitest, Capybara, Selenium
Payments: Stripe Connect and Billing
Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku
What we’re looking for

• 3+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 2 years working with Ruby on Rails.

• Solid understanding of Rails and its ecosystem, including ActiveRecord, background jobs and the request/response cycle.

• Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks while collaborating effectively with the wider team.

• Comfortable working across the stack, including JavaScript and CSS when needed.

• Familiarity with writing tests using Minitest, RSpec or similar.

• Comfortable debugging and troubleshooting production issues.

• Good communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical challenges, trade-offs and blockers clearly.

• Excited to work in a small, fast-moving product team alongside experienced engineers.

Why join us?
Stora offers a collaborative environment where you’ll have room to grow, contribute and do meaningful product work.
We value honesty, humility and responsibility. We encourage everyone to contribute ideas, take ownership of their role and help us improve the way we build.
As part of Stora , you’ll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on our product and play an important role in a rapidly evolving industry.
Benefits and compensation

• Competitive salary: From £50,000 (or Euro equivalent)

• Remote work: Fully remote within the UK or EU. Candidates must be based in either the United Kingdom or the European Union.

• Office access: Use of our Belfast office for those who live locally.

• Health and wellness: Private health insurance for you and your family.

• Retirement: Company pension plan.

• Leave: 35 days paid annual leave inclusive of public holidays (dependent on location)

title: Financial Planning & Analysis Lead
description:
We are seeking a commercially driven, hands-on FP&A leader to oversee company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis. This role will work closely with the CFO, VP of Finance, and Controller in a private equity-backed SaaS environment.
The successful candidate will lead financial planning cycles, maintain core financial models, manage SaaS performance reporting, and provide actionable insights to senior leadership. This role requires strong financial modeling skills, solid business acumen, and the ability to translate financial data into strategic recommendations.
Key Responsibilities:
A. Financial Planning & Forecasting

• Lead the annual operating plan (AOP) and rolling forecast process

• Maintain and enhance integrated financial models (P&L and cash flow; balance sheet exposure preferred but not required as full build ownership)

• Support annual budget preparation and board-level presentation materials

• Develop driver-based models and scenario analyses to support business decisions

• Deliver monthly forecast updates incorporating actuals, headcount, operating expenses, and revenue projections

B. SaaS Revenue & KPI Analysis

• Track and analyze recurring revenue metrics (ARR, bookings, churn, retention)

• Support revenue forecasting in partnership with Sales and Revenue teams

• Provide insights on SaaS unit economics and revenue performance trends

• Ensure alignment between financial reports and CRM-reported revenue data

C. Reporting & Executive Support

• Prepare monthly and quarterly management reports

• Deliver variance analysis (budget vs actual, forecast vs actual)

• Build executive dashboards and board-ready financial summaries

• Support strategic initiatives through financial modeling and investment analysis

D. Systems & Process Improvement

• Coordinate data alignment between finance and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce and accounting systems)

• Improve reporting accuracy and consistency

• Streamline financial reporting processes through Excel-based improvements and structured templates

• Support finance system enhancements as needed

E. Business Partnership

• Partner with department heads to align budgets with business priorities

• Provide financial guidance to improve cost efficiency and margin performance

• Support leadership in decision-making through data-driven insights

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field

• 5 to 10 years of progressive FP&A or corporate finance experience

• Experience in a high-growth or subscription/recurring revenue environment

• Experience in SaaS or technology companies preferred

• Strong financial modeling skills in Excel, including budgeting, forecasting, and scenario modeling

• Experience preparing management- or executive-level reports, board reporting

• Understanding of subscription revenue metrics such as ARR, MRR, and revenue forecasting

• Experience working with CRM (e.g., Salesforce) preferred

• Experience with accounting systems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or similar)

• Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)

• Strong analytical skills with attention to detail

• Ability to work independently in a lean, high-accountability environment

• Strong communication skills with the ability to partner with senior stakeholders

Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have:

• Proven ownership of budgeting and forecasting cycles

• Experience building and maintaining financial models to support business planning

• Exposure to executive or board reporting

• Working knowledge of SaaS revenue dynamics

• Ability to balance technical financial modeling with strategic business support

• Experience operating in a lean team structure

title: Senior WordPress Developer
description:
About Nexcess
Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.
About Nexcess

Nexcess delivers specialized cloud infrastructure designed for environments where peak performance and rigorous compliance are non-negotiable. Supporting a global client base ranging from high-growth agencies to mission-critical enterprise operations, we have established a legacy rooted in technical proficiency and collaborative client success. Our managed environments are backed by a dedicated team of experts committed to operational excellence and reliable execution when it counts most.
We also build the software that runs on top of that infrastructure - The Events Calendar, LearnDash, Kadence, and SolidWP among them - installed on millions of WordPress sites worldwide.
Compensation: The base salary for this role is between $80,000-$120,000 and varies based on location, experience, and skill set.
Description
We are hiring several Senior Software Engineers to work across the two halves of what we do: the managed WordPress, WooCommerce, and Magento hosting platform itself, and the WordPress products that run on it. We will work out the best fit with you during the interview process rather than asking you to choose up front.
Platform Cloud covers the hosting platform: provisioning and lifecycle, the PHP request path, caching layers, database performance, and the reliability of customer sites at scale. Products and Solutions covers our WordPress product portfolio: core APIs, the Block Editor, and writing upgrade-safe code that ships to an enormous and completely uncontrolled installed base.
What both tracks have in common is the person we are looking for: someone comfortable on both sides of the wp-config. You write the PHP, and you understand the server executing it. When a page is slow, you do not stop at "the plugin is slow" - you know whether it is a query plan, a cold object cache, a saturated PHP-FPM worker pool, or genuinely your code. That operational instinct is what separates this role from a typical WordPress job.
This is a permanently remote full-time position. We hire globally, wherever we can legally engage you. The one hard scheduling requirement is at least four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time, roughly 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM ET, so you can pair, review, and respond alongside the rest of the team.
Responsibilities

• Own substantial features and systems end to end - design, implementation, testing, rollout, and what happens after rollout

• Build and ship across the platform and product surfaces that customers touch every day

• Diagnose and fix performance problems end to end, from a slow query, through the cache layer, to the response a visitor actually waits for

• Write PHP that survives contact with the real world: hostile plugins, ancient data, and site owners who will do things you did not anticipate

• Contribute to the consolidation and modernization of systems as we bring platforms together under one architecture, without breaking the sites already depending on them

• Design within our architecture, and know when to push back on it

• Break down ambiguous problems into work that can actually be shipped incrementally

• Write and maintain automated tests, treating them as part of the feature rather than an afterthought

• Participate in code review as a first-class activity - give feedback that makes the codebase better and the author stronger

• Improve the tooling, scripts, and pipelines that let the whole team ship with confidence, and automate the operational work that would otherwise be done by hand

About Kalepa :

Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.

We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time.

Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started.

Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber.

Our Values (This is important):

Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.

Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles:

•
Hustle and Determination - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.

•
Deliver Customer Impact - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.

•
Meritocracy - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.

•
Transparency - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.

•
Experiment Relentlessly - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.

In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).

title: Information Security Engineer
Security Engineer, Detection and Response
description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build.

We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next.

We view detection and response as a software engineering discipline: detections are code, platforms are products, and measurement matters

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

- Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up.

- Contribute to the detection platform, including rule lifecycle management, tuning, measurement, and rollout safety.

- Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills - able to spot gaps in logic or missing scenarios.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

SKELAR - це venture builder, який будує міжнародні продуктові IT-компанії за правилами світу венчурних інвестицій. Разом із ко-фаундерами збираємо сильні команди, щоб запускати продуктові IT-бізнеси та перемагати на глобальних ринках.

Зараз ми в пошуку Middle/Senior User Acquisition Manager.

Brighterly - EdTech-бізнес: навчаємо дітей у США математики та читання. Ми будуємо освітню екосистему, щоб стати «домашньою сторінкою» з вивчення шкільних предметів для дітей та їхніх батьків.

Тисячі дітей щодня проходять уроки на нашій платформі. Бізнес зростає втричі рік до року, а ринок визнав наш продукт: Brighterly очолив рейтинг World's EdTech Rising Stars 2026 за версією журналу TIME.

Зараз працюємо з трьома джерелами трафіку: Meta - основне, TikTok та Google - у стадії R&D.

В твою зону відповідальності буде входити:

- Управління та масштабування Meta Ads. Це основний канал трафіку, бюджети на який ростуть щомісяця. Твоє завдання - масштабувати канал, покращуючи ефективність.

- TikTok. Ми вже запустили цей канал, зараз він у стадії R&D, але бачимо позитивну динаміку. Розвитком TikTok уже займається креативний маркетолог, а твоє завдання - взяти на себе user acquisition на цьому сорсі та вивести його на цільові показники.

- Глибока робота з аналітикою: від маркетингових метрик до юніт-економіки та LTV.

- Пошук і тестування нових підходів до залучення користувачів: нетворкінг, відкриті джерела тощо.

- Розвиток автоматизацій для user acquisition. У нас уже є інструмент автоматизації, який закриває частину ручної роботи. Ти зможеш розвивати його, щоб автоматизувати повторювані процеси.

- Побудова процесів і системи ухвалення рішень в User Acquisition. У тебе буде свобода в реалізації ідей.

Що для нас важливо:

- 2+ роки в user acquisition / performance-маркетингу

- Досвід масштабування Meta Ads - можеш поділитись кейсом, як виростив(ла) канал і що відбувалося з ефективністю.

- Don't settle for mediocrity: ти не задовольняєшся посереднім результатом, завжди шукаєш, як досягти кращого, і ставиш під сумнів поточні підходи.

- Досвід роботи з TikTok Ads, Google або іншими джерелами трафіку буде плюсом

Що пропонуємо

- Зону відповідальності з великим впливом на бізнес: user acquisition - один із ключових драйверів росту компанії.

- Можливість стати лідером ключового напряму та побудувати команду в бізнесі, який пройшов «долину смерті» й масштабується.

- Бюджети, які ростуть, і свободу тестувати нові канали та підходи.

Шукаємо людину, яка вже масштабувала paid-канали і хоче взяти на себе user acquisition у швидкозростаючому стартапі з world-class продуктом - спочатку руками, далі з командою.

Окрім бізнесів, ми маємо Благодійний фонд SKELAR, який допомагає із забезпеченням українських захисників та захисниць амуніцією та технікою, а також підтримує зовнішні military-проєкти.

SKELAR - середовище для самореалізації людей, які здатні створити успішні компанії. Ми такі компанії називаємо the next big everything. Віримо в їх потужність та масштаб.

Ми плануємо й надалі розвивати tech-бізнеси, підкорювати глобальні ринки та працювати задля перемоги України 🇺🇦

Для цього створили всі можливості всередині нашого venture builder’a:

- 8 інфраструктурних команд, які допомагають стартапам закривати будь-які питання: від рекрутингу до фінансів та юридичних питань.

- Спільнота фаундерів, які вже запустили не один бізнес й можуть ділитися практичним досвідом.

- Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: маркетинг, розробка, фінанси, рекрутинг.

- Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій.

- Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар та психолог.

Давай разом будувати the next big everything!

title: Director of People & Culture (m/f/d)
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Director of People & Culture (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your Responsibilities

- Own RobCo's people strategy end-to-end, from vision to execution

- Build and lead a high-impact People function that scales with the business

- Scale hiring across engineering, GTM, and operations with speed and quality

- Design performance systems that drive accountability and results

- Raise the bar on people leadership across the company

- Be a strategic partner to the C-suite on org design, succession, and leadership development

- Build competitive, scalable compensation, equity, and benefits programs

- Operationalize culture and values so they reinforce execution

- Lead change as the company grows in size, geography, and complexity

- Run a KPI-driven People function, using data to monitor org health and guide every strategic decision

- Champion AI adoption to modernize and scale day-to-day People operations

We're looking for someone who has:

- Proven VP/Head of People experience in high-growth, venture-backed companies

- Track record scaling teams through rapid growth phases (e.g., Series B → D)

- Builder mentality: comfortable creating systems from scratch

- Sharp business judgment, executive presence, and a data-driven approach

- High standards for performance, talent, and leadership

- Ability to operate strategically and hands-on

- Genuine curiosity about emerging technology and a drive to innovate within People & Culture

Why join RobCo?

- Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

- Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

- As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

- Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

- Flexible working hours, a modern office, and-depending on the role-the option to work from home.

- Regular team events-from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

title: Design Engineer
description: SpAItial is pioneering Physically-grounded World Models, a new AI paradigm designed to generate and reason about the appearance and physics of real and imagined environments. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the geometry of our world, redefining how industries from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema create and interact with 3D environments. We are looking for our first Design Engineer to own the design system and product experience across SpAItial's web and mobile surfaces. You will translate the company brand into reusable product patterns, clear interaction models, and production-quality front-end experiences that you can help design and ship. You will work closely with product engineers to design how people create, explore, and edit 3D worlds across web and mobile. You own product design, interaction models, reusable components, prototypes, and production front-end implementation. This is a hands-on role for someone equally comfortable maintaining a design system, resolving the details of a complex product flow, and shipping high-quality interfaces. We care far more about the quality and range of your work than where you have worked. Show us design systems you have built, web and mobile products you have shipped, and examples of how your designs held together from concept through implementation. Responsibilities Brand and design system. Translate SpAItial's brand into practical rules for typography, colour, iconography, layout, components, and interaction across product and company surfaces. Design infrastructure. Own shared Figma libraries, components, variables, templates, and documentation so teams can build consistent experiences without redesigning common patterns.

title: Accountant (AP + AR)
description:

Job Title: Accounting Specialist (Bookkeeping, AR & Payroll)
Location | Remote

We are looking for an Accounting Specialist to take over day-to-day accounting for a growing US business. You will handle billing, payroll, card reconciliation and bookkeeping in NetSuite, and work directly with the business owner and their CPA.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage accounts receivable: bill customers and follow up on payments
- Make sure employees are paid correctly and on time

- 3-4 years of experience in accounting or bookkeeping
- Hands-on experience with NetSuite
- Experience with accounts receivable, payroll and card reconciliation

Preferred Qualifications:
- Spanish language skills
- Experience taking over accounting work from an outside agency
- Experience working directly with a CPA

Tools & Technology:
- NetSuite
- Google Workspace
- Slack, Zoom, and other remote collaboration tools

Please NOTE:
It is crucial that you complete the application form in full. As part of the application process, you will be required to record a video. If your application is successful, you will receive an email confirming next steps-the video is the first step of the interview process. If you do not record a video, we will not be able to consider you for ANY open role.

title: Website Lead
description:
Ready to Get Shit Done?
At bunq, we're reshaping how people experience banking globally. Our website is the digital front door, where millions of potential users first discover who we are, what we offer, and why they should trust us. As a Website Lead, your mission is to own the entire website experience from strategy through execution, making sure our digital presence converts visitors into loyal users and establishes bunq as the go-to fintech solution.
Your role is to build, optimize, and scale bunq.com into a high-performing, conversion-focused asset that tells our story compellingly and gets users to sign up or download our app.

Take Ownership
As a Website Lead, you'll own:

• Develop and execute the website strategy, including technical SEO, conversion optimization, content roadmap, and mobile-first UX, driving measurable growth in sign-ups and app downloads.

• Lead website performance and optimization, implementing A/B tests, analyzing conversion funnels, identifying bottlenecks, and continuously improving KPIs (speed, engagement, conversion rate).

• Own the website tech stack and roadmap, ensuring the site scales, performs at speed, and is built with modern best practices (accessibility, mobile, core web vitals).

What You'll Work on Right Away

• Conversion Funnel Audit: Conduct a deep-dive analysis of bunq.com's current user journey from landing to sign-up, identifying friction points and quick wins to improve conversion rate.

• Mobile-First Optimization: Overhaul mobile UX and performance , implementing improvements that meaningfully impact sign-up conversion.

• AI-Powered Content Strategy: Design and launch a content strategy leveraging AI for personalization, SEO optimization, and messaging that resonates with different user segments and markets.

Do You Have What It Takes?

• Website strategy & execution expertise: Proven track record building and optimizing high-traffic websites with focus on conversion, user experience, and measurable impact.

• Technical depth: You understand site architecture, core web vitals, mobile optimization, and analytics; hands-on experience with web tech stack (front-end, performance tools, A/B testing platforms).

• Data-driven mindset: You design experiments, interpret analytics (GA4, Looker), build conversion funnels, and use data to make decisions-not gut feel.

• Product thinking: You understand user psychology, can design intuitive flows, and collaborate closely with design, content, and product teams.

• Fluency in English (ideally multilingual for our multi-market operations).

Curious to see how we make life easy? - try the bunq app , it only takes 5 minutes to sign up.

Your space to perform
We give you the space and the tools you need to succeed 💪
🤟 Great, international colleagues who share your mindset
👩‍💻 Hybrid setup: after 3 months in-office, work 2 days remote, 3 days in-office weekly.
📚 We support growth with bunq Academy and €1500 annual learning budget
🇧🇬 Flex Benefits: €70 monthly budget via Re: benefit, offering access to 150+ perks tailored to your lifestyle.
🚌 Travel expenses are covered whether you come walking or by bike, bus or car (though we prefer green choices 🌳) (in the Netherlands)
🧳 Digital Nomad Program: After your first year, enjoy up to 20 days per year to work while traveling, combining flexibility with strong team collaboration
🚀 We reward tenure with a dedicated travel budget: €1.5k after 2 years and €3k after 4 years to visit another core office.
💻 A MacBook so you can Get Shit Done with us
🥦 Delicious lunches from our fabulous in-house chefs with vegan and vegetarian options
💰 An optional pension plan with monthly contribution from bunq (in the Netherlands)
⚕️ Private health insurance, just in case (in Turkey or Bulgaria)
🧘 €60 monthly allowance via Alleo by Epassi, rolling over monthly and resetting annually (in the Netherlands)
🍻 Friday drinks and other celebrations - bunq style

All new hires are subject to Pre-employment

title: Finance Operations Intern (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena digitalisiert die Hausverwaltung in Deutschland. Wir übernehmen traditionelle Hausverwaltungen und transformieren sie in moderne, technologiegetriebene Unternehmen - mit dem Ziel, Immobilienverwaltung einfach und transparent zu machen.

DEINE ROLLE

In deiner Rolle als Praktikant im Bereich Finance Operations bildest du das verlässliche Rückgrat unseres Finanzteams. Du steuerst die kompletten Abläufe der Kreditorenbuchhaltung, begleitest aktiv die Einführung frischer Systeme sowie Abläufe und agierst als maßgebliche Schnittstelle zu externen Steuerberatern. Gleichzeitig garantierst du reibungslose, strukturierte Prozesse in unseren Tochterunternehmen. An der Seite von Finance Lead und CFO erhältst du umfassende Einblicke in sämtliche Finanzstrukturen, vom einzelnen Beleg bis zur strategischen Liquiditätssteuerung.

WAS DU TUN WIRST

- Accounts Payable: Du managst unseren Eingangsrechnungs-Workflow von A bis Z - Postkorb, Invoice Chasing, Freigabeprozesse und Zahlungen ausführen. Sorgfalt und ein Auge für Details sind hier entscheidend.

- Buchungsqualität: Du stellst sicher, dass Rechnungen mit den richtigen Konten, Kostenstellen und Steuersätzen erfasst werden. Du bist die erste Instanz, bevor Buchungen zu unseren Steuerberatern gehen, und unterstützt bei buchhalterischen Rückfragen.

- Tochtergesellschaften: Du überprüfst regelmäßig die BWAs unserer Töchter, erkennst Abweichungen und Unplausibilitäten und stellst sicher, dass vorgegebene Prozesse konsequent eingehalten werden.

- Liquiditätssteuerung & Systemimplementierung: Du erlernst die Arbeit mit Agicap - unserem zentralen Werkzeug für Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen, Zahlungsabläufe sowie das Liquiditätsmanagement. Zudem begleitest du den Rollout in unseren Tochtergesellschaften, schulst die Teams vor Ort und gewährleistest eine hohe Datenqualität und Vollständigkeit.

- Ad-hoc & Ops-Schnittstelle: Du packst auch mal an, wenn es brennt. Sei es bei Finance-nahen Sonderprojekten oder gelegentlicher Unterstützung im Ops-Bereich.

DU PASST GUT ZU UNS, WENN

- Du Ownership liebst und nicht wartest, bis jemand anderes eine Rechnung sucht, einen Fehler korrigiert oder einen Prozess aufräumt - du siehst es, du löst es.

- Du Buchungen nicht als lästiges Pflichtprogramm siehst, sondern verstehst, warum die Kontenwahl relevant ist - für das Reporting, für die Steuer, für das große Ganze.

- Du dich in einem Tool schnell zurechtfindest, das du vorher noch nie gesehen hast. Agicap, Moss, Lucanet, Datev - wenn du eines davon kennst, lernst du die anderen schnell.

- Du in Unklarheit handlungsfähig bleibst. In einem Startup sind Prozesse oft im Aufbau. Du baust mit, anstatt auf fertige Strukturen zu warten.

- Du Qualität mit Pragmatismus verbindest. Du machst es richtig - aber du weißt auch, wann „gut genug“ besser ist als „perfekt in drei Wochen“.

- Du fließend Deutsch und Englisch sprichst. Die Kommunikation mit unseren Steuerberatern und Tochtergesellschaften erfolgt auf Deutsch, während wir intern auf Englisch kommunizieren. Hard requirement.

- Du aus unserem Office in Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten willst. Das ist keine Remote-Rolle. Hard requirement.

WAS DU BEKOMMST

- Bis zu €500 Office-Nähe-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10-20 Gehminuten zum Office wohnst (oder hinziehst).

- €110/Monat Mittagessen-Budget, €50 monatlicher Fitness-Zuschuss.

- €1.200 jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

- Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

title: TECHNICAL LEAD
description:

description:
About NOCD
NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.
About the Role
As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD , we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.
NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPCC, LMFT, LCSW) in New Mexico to join our team.
As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.
You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

• Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

The Customer Growth Manager owns the full customer lifecycle - onboarding, retention, renewal, and expansion - for several hundred of KidKare's smallest sponsor accounts, assigned by state.

title: Senior COBOL Developer (z/OS) - LATAM Remote
description:
Workstate seeks a Senior COBOL Developer to join our team for an 18-month modernization project! In this role, you will convert a legacy RPG II codebase to COBOL on IBM z/OS in preparation for a cloud migration to Google Cloud Platform using the Raincode mainframe rehosting platform. If you are a strong COBOL engineer who enjoys working with data and delivering high-quality results for clients, you'll fit right in at Workstate .
We aim to engage consultants who can motivate and galvanize our clients, while diving deeply into the work at hand and envisioning future projects. Our consultants are skilled decision-makers, committed to championing client visions and driving quality results.
This position is fully remote and available to people residing in Colombia or Argentina with the right to work in that country.
Requirements
The ideal candidate will have 6+ years of professional COBOL development experience on IBM z/OS mainframes. Beyond that, we're looking for some of the following skills, but not necessarily all:

• Strong SQL and data skills, especially DB2 for z/OS (embedded SQL, query tuning, data modeling)

• JCL, TSO/ISPF and batch processing

• VSAM, QSAM/sequential files and GDGs

• Mainframe utilities such as DFSORT/SYNCSORT and IDCAMS

• CICS

• Legacy modernization, code conversion or mainframe migration projects

• Mainframe rehosting or emulation platforms (Raincode, Micro Focus/Rocket Enterprise Server) or GCP

• Source control and change management tools (Git, Endevor, ChangeMan)

• Data validation, reconciliation and parallel-run testing

• C1 level (advanced) or higher English, written and verbal. You will work directly with US-based client teams and need to communicate as comfortably as a US-based colleague.

You do not need RPG II experience. Engineers joining the project are trained on it. Prior experience with RPG II or other IBM midrange languages is a plus.
Job Duties

• Convert legacy RPG II programs into well-structured, maintainable COBOL on z/OS

• Analyze existing program logic, file layouts and data flows to make sure the converted code behaves the same way

• Develop and maintain JCL, batch job streams and related utilities

• Write and tune SQL (DB2 for z/OS) and work with VSAM and sequential datasets

• Take part in unit, regression and parallel testing, including data validation and reconciliation between legacy and converted output

• Prepare code and data for rehosting on GCP with the Raincode compiler and runtime

• Document converted programs, data dependencies and technical decisions

• Work with the client's technical and migration teams in an Agile setting

title: Business Control Manager

About the role

We are hiring a Business Control Manager to join Chime’s Compliance Business Control Management team, with a primary focus on control delivery for Growth Marketing and Chime Enterprise. You will partner with business and control owners to translate agreed risk outcomes into practical controls that provide the right level of risk mitigation while working effectively for the business. • Hands-on experience taking a control or process improvement from a defined problem or requirement through implementation, evidence review, documentation, and closure.

• Strong execution and project-management skills, including managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, decisions, and stakeholders while adapting to changing complexity, urgency, and team priorities.

title: Sales Development Manager
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re hiring a Sales Development Manager (New York City or San Francisco) to lead and scale our founding SDR team at LangChain.

Our SDRs play a critical role in helping companies adopt LangChain and LangSmith. They engage technical buyers, convert high inbound interest into qualified opportunities, and work closely with our sales and marketing teams to build pipeline.

This role will own the performance, coaching, and development of the SDR team, while helping design the systems, processes, and workflows that power their GTM motion. You’ll partner closely with sales, marketing, and and RevOps to continuously improve how we identify and engage the right accounts.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Lead and coach a team of SDRs responsible for generating qualified pipeline

- Own SDR performance including activity metrics, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and attainment

- Recruit top SDR talent and grow the team as LangChain continues to scale

- Develop SDR talent through coaching, call reviews, and structured feedback

- Build repeatable outbound and inbound qualification playbooks

- Partner with marketing to convert inbound demand into qualified opportunities

- Work with sales leadership and RevOps to align on target accounts, territories, and pipeline goals

- Implement systems and workflows that improve SDR productivity and effectiveness

- Use data to continuously improve performance, analyzing conversion rates across the funnel

HOW TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:

- Have 5+ years of experience in sales development

- Have 1-3+ years managing SDRs or leading a sales development team

- Are comfortable working with technical products and developer audiences

- Have experience with modern GTM tooling (AI Agents, LinkedIn Sales Nav, Power Dialers, etc.)

- Are highly data-driven and comfortable managing performance through metrics

- Are passionate about coaching and developing early-career sales talent

- Thrive in fast-moving environments where processes are still evolving

- Have strong communication and organizational skills

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

description:

As electric vehicles (EVs) drive a transformation of the transport and mobility sectors, AMPECO is at the forefront of that grand revolution, and we’re just getting started.

Our product - the AMPECO EV Charging Platform - is a business-critical SaaS platform used by companies to manage their EV charging infrastructure, processes and energy use. It’s already in use by companies all over the world, from North and South America to Europe, Asia and Australia.

Our team is highly motivated, capable, and committed to our mission. We are looking to expand it with like-minded, capable people, eager to give, learn and grow with us.

About the Role

As a Solutions Architecture Lead at AMPECO you will be a senior individual contributor who guides customers through the architecture, design, and delivery of complex technical projects, from the first conversation to a successful project go-live.

You will work on specific engagements and can join as early as the pre-sales stage. With a new prospect, you will help define the overall solution architecture and migration strategy. You will also own the planning, estimation, and risk assessment that support bidding and contracting.

Once a prospect becomes an AMPECO customer, you will lead their onboarding and migration. When the project is complete, you will hand them over smoothly to a business-as-usual setup. As existing customers take on new integrations or complex initiatives, you might again lead the planning and delivery.

Why this role matters

title: Senior IA Inference Engineer (x/f/m)
description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Senior Inference Engineer to join the ML Platform (TIGER) team in AI & Machine Learning.

Your mission will be to power Doctolib's AI-driven healthcare products - from Consultation Assistant to Phone Assistant and Health Companion - by owning the self-hosted LLM serving platform that keeps the most sensitive patient data within infrastructure Doctolib controls. You will build and operate the shared foundations that every AI feature team relies on: deploying, tuning, and scaling open-weight models across our GPU fleet, contributing directly to faster, safer, and more cost-efficient AI for care teams and patients across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Build the shared LLM serving foundations with MLOps engineers - define the serving stack, GPU capacity planning, and deployment automation for open-weight models (Gemma, Mistral, Llama, Qwen, and their fine-tuned variants) on Ray Serve / Anyscale, while shaping the evolution toward Kubernetes-based orchestration

- Own the model registry and promotion path - establish clear processes for versioning, validating, and promoting models into production, benchmark performance and output quality under realistic workloads, and maintain the curated model catalog together with the Agents Platform team

- Optimize inference performance and efficiency - operate and tune serving engines (vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM) to reduce time-to-first-token, inter-token latency, and cost per token through batching, caching, quantization, and parallelism strategies across our GPU fleet (L4 to H200)

- Own production reliability and disaster recovery - define SLOs, run load tests before launches, implement safe rollouts, rollbacks, and autoscaling, and participate in on-call and incident response

- Make serving performance and costs measurable - build Datadog dashboards, alerting, and cost reporting to track latency, GPU utilization, and inference spend, and identify opportunities to improve resource efficiency

- Keep the inference stack secure, compliant, and evolving - work with Security and Privacy on network isolation, data residency, and auditability, while continuously assessing new models, serving engines (such as SGLang), and GPU generations

WHO YOU ARE

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

- Have 5+ years of software or computer engineering experience, including hands-on production experience with at least one LLM serving engine (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, or Triton) - ideally having chosen, introduced, tuned, or scaled one in production, not just run it with defaults

- Are proficient in Python and Terraform, with a solid understanding of transformer inference mechanics: prefill vs. decode, KV cache, batching strategies, and why a model is compute- or memory-bound on a given GPU

- Have strong experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes or a managed Ray / Anyscale platform, and a performance engineering mindset - you design reproducible benchmarks, read profiler output, and back decisions with numbers

- Are comfortable owning production reliability: observability, incident response, and on-call are a natural part of the role

- Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, high agency, a pragmatic build-vs-buy approach, and are comfortable working in a scope that is still taking shape

- Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

- Have experience with distributed serving frameworks (KServe, llm-d, NVIDIA Dynamo), including disaggregated prefill/decode or KV-cache-aware routing, or with serving Mixture-of-Experts, multimodal models, or many LoRA adapters

Job Title: In-Home Health - Physician (Part Time) - Lansing, MI
Job Location: Work at Home, Michigan, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part-time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Part-time employees qualify for:

• Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

• Able to cover the following primary locations: Clinton, Eaton, Ingham, Jackson, Shiawassee

Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. • Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts such as eventual consistency, idempotency, fault tolerance, and retry strategies

• Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers and contributing to architectural decision-making processes

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams including product, design, and DevOps

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer | Data Engineering Platform | Hybrid Working | Krakow

Introduction:

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role As a Data Engineer within our Data Engineering Platform team, you will be responsible for building, operating, and enhancing the core infrastructure, services, and data pipelines that power analytics and reporting across two of our key warehouse automation and fulfilment platforms: Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) and Ocado Mobile Robotics Solutions (OMRS). You will work closely across the stack-moving seamlessly between application code, data pipelines, and infrastructure-while driving platform modernisation by tackling technical debt, tuning Airflow orchestration, and optimizing cloud resource usage.

In this role, you will play an active part in monitoring, alerting, and incident response to maintain system health and ensure issues are resolved before they impact our customers. Additionally, you will maintain and improve a live, customer-facing slot-availability application, focusing on high reliability and optimal performance. Working as part of a collaborative, distributed team, you will partner with engineering groups across Ocado Group to deliver scalable, cost-effective data capabilities and secure interfaces for stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Build, run, and improve data pipelines, backend services, and APIs powering analytics and reporting for OSP and OMRS.

• Write and evolve Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu) for cloud environments.

• Modernise the platform by untangling technical debt and tuning Airflow/Composer (right-sizing pools, setting K8s resource requests, and optimising DAGs).

• Improve platform efficiency and cloud infrastructure costs by identifying wasteful queries, idle resources, and optimising BigQuery usage.

• Participate in monitoring, alerting, and incident response to maintain system health and customer trust.

• Maintain and enhance the reliability and performance of a live, customer-facing slot-availability application.

• Collaborate closely with distributed engineering teams and key stakeholders across Ocado Group.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

• Solid software engineering experience in Python.

• Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, or similar like Ansible/CloudFormation) on GCP or another major cloud provider.

• Strong grasp of core DevOps practices, including source control workflows, CI/CD, and deployment strategy design.

• Comfort working across the stack, moving between application code, pipelines, and infrastructure.

• Pragmatic, ownership-minded approach with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems and adapt to shifting priorities.

• Fluent written and spoken English with hands-on exposure to Python, TypeScript, Terraform, GCP, BigQuery, Airflow, CI/CD, and PostgreSQL.

Nice to Haves

• Experience with TypeScript/Node.js.

• Advanced hands-on Airflow experience beyond writing DAGs (e.g., tuning scheduler pools, resource allocation, and diagnosing slow pipelines).

• Exposure to dbt, BigQuery, or other cloud data warehouse tooling.

• Experience supporting live, customer-facing production systems, Unix/Linux environments, and core security principles (least privilege, separation of duties).

This role description summarises the typical functions of the role. It is not an exhaustive list of all possible responsibilities, tasks, or duties.

Benefits: What’s in it for you? 

Work and life should fit together, so we offer a range of benefits focusing on well-being, development, and team spirit. The final package will depend on the contract type we agree on.

title: Pricing Strategist
description:
About the Team

The Pricing & Monetization team is responsible for how our products create and capture value. We partner closely with Product, GTM, and Finance to design pricing models, packaging, and commercial strategies that support adoption, growth, and long-term scaling of the business.

To thrive on this team, you need to be a proactive problem-solver who excels at bringing structure to ambiguous challenges. Our work demands strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and precision in execution. Team members succeed when they are analytical, detail-oriented, skilled at balancing multiple priorities, and passionate about driving high-stakes projects forward to deliver meaningful results.

About the Role

We are looking for a Pricing Strategist with strong analytical skills and hands-on pricing experience to shape how we price, package, and monetize ChatGPT and Codex, with model pricing as a core part of the role. You’ll work closely with senior leaders across Product, GTM, and Finance to define pricing approaches, improve commercial decision-making, and bring more rigor to how we monetize our offerings.

You should be comfortable doing deep analysis, digging into how our products work, and translating that understanding into clear pricing recommendations. You should also care deeply about the customer perspective and believe that strong pricing reflects a real understanding of customer value, needs, and friction points in order to build pricing that is clear, fair, and aligned with how customers experience our products. This role will report to the Head of Product Pricing for Chat & Codex.

In this role, you will:

- Develop pricing and packaging strategy across plan usage limits and entitlements, credits and overages, and emerging monetization models, balancing customer value, growth, and unit economics.

- Develop clear recommendations that are grounded in customer preferences, product value, and market dynamics.

- Establish lightweight but effective pricing governance, including decision frameworks, approval processes, and performance tracking.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 6+ years of experience in a strategy role (e.g., consulting or business operations).

- Have 3+ years of hands-on pricing and monetization experience, with a track record of developing and launching self-serve subscription or usage-based offerings; experience with sales-led motions is a plus.

- Are deeply familiar with various monetization models, including seat-based subscriptions and usage-based pricing models.

- Have exceptional analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to independently analyze complex data, build financial models, pressure-test assumptions, and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.

- Can balance customer value, product strategy, and commercial outcomes in a thoughtful way.

- Are comfortable influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders and navigating ambiguous decisions.

- Are a self-starter who can roll up their sleeves and operate comfortably in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.

title: Robot Transporter (C1 Driver)
description:
We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/ and company https://www.monumental.co/about/. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel https://www.youtube.com/@buildmonumental, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll transport robots that build houses. You’ll load them at our Amsterdam workshop, get them onto construction sites, and bring them back for repairs before their next job. When a team needs a replacement robot to keep building, you’re the person who gets it there.

We’re hiring our first Robot Transporter. We already have 150+ robots in the field and we’re expanding from the Netherlands into the UK and US. You’ll be the first person dedicated to getting our robots, equipment and materials where they need to be, helping more teams build more homes.

Your day could take you from the workshop to several active construction sites, delivering robots, collecting systems for repair and getting equipment to the next crew. You’ll work out the order of stops, what fits in each vehicle, and how to load and secure it safely. You’ll drive a C1 truck or B-licence van, work closely with our deployment team, and get to know the robots and the people building with them.

This is practical, physical work with room to take charge. You’ll start by planning alongside the deployment team, then take ownership of routes and transport requests as you learn the sites and loads. Plans change, sites get muddy, and teams depend on you. You’ll see the houses going up and know you helped get them built.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Drive. Operate our leased C1 truck and B-licence van across the Netherlands, usually two or more movements a day. When a move needs a flatbed with forklift loading, you arrange it.

- Plan the day’s transport. Work with the deployment team on the day’s plan: what goes in which vehicle, and the order of drop-offs and pick-ups across sites, our Groningen hub and our Amsterdam locations. Over time, more of this becomes yours to own.

- Load and secure. Robots, hoisting cages, scaffolding, inventory kits, equipment. You know weight limits, lashing and what it takes to get a 400+ kg system in and out of a vehicle safely.

- Run deployment logistics. Systems, kits and operational tools out to a new site before the team arrives, back to the workshop when a build wraps, and everything in between.

- Keep the fleet where it's useful. Move idle systems from one site to another that needs them, and bring systems back for repair so that a broken robot swapped today is a wall going up tomorrow.

- Own the vehicles. Servicing, inspections, cleaning, fuel, damage reporting and fines. Vehicles are always road-ready.

- Log every move. Each transport is recorded in our fleet tooling so deployment managers see when their request is planned and the company always knows where every system and kit is.

title: Staff Product Operations
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

TEAM CONTEXT

The AI Transformation Office (AITO), part of AI Core, is Nubank's central office driving the company-wide AI transformation. We orchestrate all of the AI workstreams - including function transformation, infrastructure, AI risk, AI cost and communications - and work directly with Nubank's management team and senior leaders across the company.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You join a small core team as the person who brings the outside view: first-hand experience of how an AI plays a key role at a company that is further along. You'll use it to shape where Nubank's transformation goes next, decide which AI solutions we build or buy, and structure how progress reaches the management team - while staying hands-on enough to unblock the initiatives that matter most.

Impact: you will shape the direction, reach and quality of Nubank's AI transformation.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Shape Nubank's AI strategy with industry learnings. Bring what worked and failed at top players to define where Nubank goes next - what to double down on, what to stop, how to sequence it, and which operating model fits.

- Define our AI solutions portfolio. Map the AI solutions we have internally and support build-vs-buy calls - which tools, harnesses and context layers Nubank should build in-house versus source externally - and shape the scope of the ones we build.

- Own the management team narrative. Structure what goes to Nubank's management team every week - turning signals from every workstream into a clear picture of progress, risks and the decisions needed.

- Define what success looks like. Set ambitious targets for our AI initiatives and the KPIs, measures, and mechanisms that show whether they are actually delivering impact.

- Unblock critical initiatives. When something is stuck, go into the team, understand the blocker and resolve it - across functions, without formal authority.

- Run the operating rhythm. Lead weekly workstream sessions with initiative owners on gaps, ETAs and resourcing; connect cross-workstream dependencies and escalate risks early.

- Outstanding written, storytelling and visual communication

title: Cx, QA, & Field Engineer, Electrical
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
